contracts.evidence: Metal::validate checks current finite/range policy and nested engraving; ValidatedMetal retains immutable admitted recipe. MetalTextureSize admits32..1024, checked texels/word projections preserve actual allocation/bake size. No new tuning/geometry policy inferred.

MetalTextures private construction checks exact RGBA8 map byte counts and optional depth uv scale; getters preserve layout while into_maps explicitly transfers ownership. Preview consumes the admitted size and maps; export encodes actual tile size and preserves linear normal/metal-roughness handling.

EngravingImage retains immutable recipe plus decoded relief. Cut::new preserves path IO and image decode causes; procedural ornament uses admitted recipe. bake can intentionally take a separately resolved Cut (existing fixture uses this), so review does not invent equality with Metal.engraving as an additional precondition.

contracts.disposition: Source consistent, numerical policy bounded by documented host_float limits
contracts.evidence: admit_extent separately bounds positive dimensions and signed wrap remainder addition. admit_samples uses actual tile pixel centers, actual f32 rotation coefficients and four corner extrema of the fenced affine projection; it checks finite floor plus floor+1 against i32 bounds before image upload. This checks computed sampling coordinates, beyond u32 image word-count decoding. No source claim of global runtime/device health follows.

Baking uses typed texel/word extents, handles fallible batch submission/readback, creates checked CPU map packets only after required reads. Native validation observation and progress/completion remain configured lower-helper policy; later failures do not promise rollback of prior work. Reference-only MetalGpu/Buffer/context helpers must be composed with Root-owned sources, not overwritten.

actionable_comment_findings.mismatch: Actual host_float documents rare transcendental rounding differences (lines23-28), fused-FMA requirements/device-local test evidence, subnormal flushing and bounded trig reduction (lines51-57). The validated material contract accepts finite subnormal waviness/grain/scratch-depth values; admission does not discharge these limits. Fencing and seeded schedule independence do not establish universal cross-device bit identity.
actionable_comment_findings.remedy: Qualify both wrapper claims as one connected documentation repair: intermediates use host_float fences to retain the intended operation order, subject to that module's documented numerical and device limits. Retain seeded scheduling/atomic-maximum statements; do not change numeric admission, shader arithmetic, fixtures or add benchmarks.
